theme: Project Management Tools, KPI Tracking, Risk Management
discoveries: GitHub Projects (beta to GA in 2024) offers tight integration with repo code + PR/issue linking (native for technical teams)
Monday.com excels at visual timeline/Gantt + custom field automation (ideal for cross-functional visibility)
Jira remains standard for agile teams; Jira Cloud now includes portfolio management (multi-team roadmaps)
KPI tracking: burndown charts (velocity), cycle time, deployment frequency, code coverage (CI/CD dashboards)
Risk register best practice: weekly review cadence, probability×impact scoring (3×3 matrix), mitigation assignment
recommendations: Adopt GitHub Projects for technical work (code+issues unified); Monday.com for business/cross-team coordination
Define KPI dashboard: sprint velocity, on-time delivery rate, bug escape rate, team satisfaction (NPS)
Implement risk register in Notion (searchable, version-controlled) with weekly review in standups
Automate burndown calculation via GitHub Actions → Slack integration (daily update in #progress-tracker)
Establish incident severity levels (P1/P2/P3) with SLA response times for escalation
